supporting_observations.claim: At 13:41:52 UTC, ivy.chen's Microsoft Word process opened Statement.docm and spawned PowerShell with no-profile, hidden-window, and encoded-command options.
The encoded PowerShell command decodes to an instruction to execute content downloaded from raw.githubusercontent.com/nwd-it/tools/main/u.ps1; the proxy logged a successful GET for that exact URL.
The PowerShell process spawned rundll32 to call Init in C:\Users\ivy.chen\AppData\Roaming\svchelper.dll, then both PowerShell and rundll32 exited shortly afterward.

The observed Word-to-hidden-PowerShell-to-downloaded-script and user-profile DLL execution chain is consistent with malicious activity, not a legitimate explanation identified in the supplied environment context.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied proxy record shows the requested script URL and HTTP success status, but does not include the downloaded script body.
The supplied records show rundll32 launched with the DLL path, but do not establish the DLL's contents or whether its entry point completed.
The reported brief PowerShell-window appearance is not independently established: the process record includes a hidden-window option, but the logs do not show what the user saw.
claims_not_established: The contents and behavior of u.ps1 and svchelper.dll are not established by the supplied records.
The evidence does not establish whether the script or DLL achieved persistence, executed additional actions, or caused data access or exfiltration.
The evidence does not establish whether the document was intentionally opened by ivy.chen or how it arrived on the workstation.
additional_evidence_needed: Acquire and analyze Statement.docm, the downloaded u.ps1 content, and C:\Users\ivy.chen\AppData\Roaming\svchelper.dll; preserve hashes and timestamps.
Collect endpoint forensic data for WS-ICHEN-01 around 13:41 UTC, including process and script execution artifacts, relevant file and registry changes, and any persistence or follow-on activity.
Review proxy or network-side retained content and related connections to determine what the download returned and whether other destinations were contacted.
Contain and investigate WS-ICHEN-01 and assess whether ivy.chen credentials or other organizational assets were affected.
unrelated_findings: At 13:32 UTC, records show sam.okafor authentication from WS-ICHEN-01 to WS-SOKAFOR-01. This is inconsistent with the supplied practice that remote administration is only done from WS-SOKAFOR-01; investigate separately and do not use it to decide this alert. (T043-00080, T043-00082, T043-00084)
ZoomUpdate.exe ran on WS-ICHEN-01 at 14:03 UTC. Zoom is not listed among the supplied approved software; review separately. (T043-00203, T043-00204, T043-00205, T043-00206)
